verdicts.note: The cited lines [S1][S2] attack 'burdensome agency rules and regulations that undermine individual rights and our economic prosperity' and pledge to 'battle state government when it stands in the way of our prosperity' (the pamphlet says 'our prosperity', not 'local prosperity'). That is deregulation of individuals and businesses, not a stated position on state mandates over local governments, zoning or regional authorities; the local-control reading is an inference.
